groups.name: core
groups.title: Events and time
groups.about: Where every mod starts: listen for something, then do something.

items.name: tl.on
items.doc: Run fn whenever an event happens. Built in: load, unload, frame(dt), second, draw, key(name, down), click(x, y), part_placed(part, kind), part_removed(part), wire_added(wire), wire_removed(wire). Any other name is a custom event.

items.name: tl.off
items.doc: Stop a listener that tl.on gave back.

items.name: tl.emit
items.doc: Send an event to every running mod, this one too.

items.name: tl.after
items.doc: Run fn once, this many seconds from now.

items.name: tl.every
items.doc: Run fn again and again, this many seconds apart.

items.name: tl.cancel
items.doc: Stop a timer from tl.after or tl.every.

items.name: tl.time
items.doc: Seconds since the mods started.

items.name: tl.log
items.doc: Write a line to this mod's console. print does the same.

items.name: tl.warn
items.doc: Write a yellow line to this mod's console.

items.name: tl.command
items.doc: Add a console command: typing `name the rest` calls fn("the rest").

items.name: tl.version
items.doc: The mod API version.

items.name: tl.id
items.doc: This mod's id.

items.name: vars
items.doc: A table shared by this mod's script and its node graph.

groups.name: mods
groups.title: Other mods
groups.about: Mods can lean on each other: one exports, another requires.

items.name: tl.export
items.doc: Offer a value or a function to other mods.

items.name: tl.require
items.doc: Everything another running mod exported, or nil and why.

items.name: tl.mods
items.doc: The ids of every running mod, in load order.

items.name: tl.call
items.doc: The raw engine interface every other function is built on. Ops: state, board, part, probe, place, wire, delete, move, rotate, set, press, clock, camera, focus, find_space, catalog, select, duplicate, truth_table, undo, redo and more. Returns the result table, or nil and why.

groups.name: board
groups.title: The board
groups.about: Place, wire, move and remove parts. Positions are in tiles.

items.name: tl.board.place
items.doc: Place a part by its finder name ("switch", "light", "nand"...). Leave x, y out for the nearest free spot. opts sets it up: {label=, on=, number=, bits=, color=}.

items.name: tl.board.chip
items.doc: Place one of the project's own chips by name.

items.name: tl.board.wire
items.doc: Wire pin_a of part a to pin_b of part b. A pin is its number (they count from 0) or its name ("out", "a"). color is 0 to 8 or a wire colour name.

items.name: tl.board.remove
items.doc: Remove parts: ids, part tables or one list of them.

items.name: tl.board.remove_wire
items.doc: Remove wires by id.

items.name: tl.board.parts
items.doc: Every part on this level, or only one kind ("light", "switch", "chip"...). Each has id, kind, name, x, y, w, h, rot, on, value, label.

items.name: tl.board.wires
items.doc: Every wire: id, from, to, color. from and to are two-item lists: w.from[1] is the part, w.from[2] is the pin. Pass true to get each wire's path and amps too.

items.name: tl.board.part
items.doc: One part with its pins, what it says and its status. Gives nothing back if the part is gone.

items.name: tl.board.pins
items.doc: A part's pins.

items.name: tl.board.set
items.doc: Change a part: {on=, number=, bits=, value=, label=, color=, rot=, flip=}.

items.name: tl.board.label
items.doc: Give a part a label.

items.name: tl.board.move
items.doc: Move a part to a tile. Its wires follow.

items.name: tl.board.rotate
items.doc: Turn a part a quarter turn, or mirror it when flip is true.

items.name: tl.board.wire_color
items.doc: Recolour a wire, 0 to 8.

items.name: tl.board.clear
items.doc: Remove everything on this level.

items.name: tl.board.find_space
items.doc: A free spot big enough for w by h tiles.

items.name: tl.board.catalog
items.doc: Everything the part finder offers.

items.name: tl.board.select
items.doc: Select these parts.

items.name: tl.board.selection
items.doc: What the player has selected.

items.name: tl.board.count
items.doc: How many parts and wires are on this level.

items.name: tl.board.undo
items.doc: Undo the last change. Everything a mod does lands in the player's undo history.

items.name: tl.board.redo
items.doc: Redo.

groups.name: sim
groups.title: The simulation
groups.about: Read what the circuit is doing and push its switches and buttons.

items.name: tl.sim.read
items.doc: What a part shows (a light's 1 or 0, a display's number), or what one pin carries.

items.name: tl.sim.read_all
items.doc: Read many parts in one go.

items.name: tl.sim.set
items.doc: Close or open a switch.

items.name: tl.sim.toggle
items.doc: Flip a switch.

items.name: tl.sim.press
items.doc: Hold a push button down, or let it go.

items.name: tl.sim.tap
items.doc: Press a push button and let go a moment later.

items.name: tl.sim.number
items.doc: Set a number input.

items.name: tl.sim.clock
items.doc: "play", "pause", "step" or "restart" a clock.

items.name: tl.sim.speed
items.doc: A clock's speed, 0 to 9.

items.name: tl.sim.step
items.doc: Step a paused clock.

items.name: tl.sim.watch
items.doc: Call fn(value, before) whenever a reading changes. pin is optional.

items.name: tl.sim.unwatch
items.doc: Stop watching.

items.name: tl.sim.state
items.doc: The editor's state: project, level, camera, parts, wires, short_circuit, unstable, clock_running...

items.name: tl.sim.truth_table
items.doc: Work out a circuit's truth table.

groups.name: elec
groups.title: Electric parts
groups.about: Settings by name for the analog parts (supplies, sources, resistors, capacitors, coils, semiconductors) and what they measure: volts, amps and meter readings.

items.name: tl.elec.settings
items.doc: Every electric setting of a part by name, as it is now, and their names in order. A resistor has ohms; a function generator hz, height, center and width; a bench supply volts and limit. Values are in SI units.

items.name: tl.elec.get
items.doc: One setting by name (nil when the part has no such setting).

items.name: tl.elec.set
items.doc: Change one setting, or several at once with a table: tl.elec.set(gen, {hz = 440, height = 2}). The same as typing it on the part's card, so one undo brings it back. A name the part doesn't have is an error that lists the ones it does.

items.name: tl.elec.volts
items.doc: The volts on a pin against ground, or between two pins of the same part when other is given.

items.name: tl.elec.amps
items.doc: The current through a part, in amps. 0 when none flows.

items.name: tl.elec.meter
items.doc: What a voltmeter (volts across its probes) or an ammeter (amps through it) reads.

items.name: tl.elec.watch
items.doc: Call fn(volts, before) whenever a pin's volts have moved by step from the last value told (0.1 V unless given). Checked once a frame.

items.name: tl.elec.unwatch
items.doc: Stop watching.

groups.name: draw
groups.title: Drawing
groups.about: tl.draw paints on the board (16 board pixels to a tile) and moves with the camera. tl.hud paints on the screen (480 by 270). Draw inside a draw or frame event: the picture is wiped every frame.

items.name: tl.draw.rect
items.sig: tl.draw.rect(x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
items.doc: A filled box on the board, in board pixels.

items.name: tl.draw.frame
items.sig: tl.draw.frame(x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
items.doc: An outline on the board.

items.name: tl.draw.text
items.doc: Words on the board.

items.name: tl.draw.measure
items.doc: How wide and tall some words come out, in pixels, before they're drawn. For centring text or putting a box behind it.

items.name: tl.draw.pixel
items.doc: One board pixel.

items.name: tl.draw.line
items.doc: A line on the board.

items.name: tl.draw.tile
items.doc: Fill one whole tile.

items.name: tl.draw.cell
items.doc: Fill a tile with a gap round it.

items.name: tl.hud.rect
items.sig: tl.hud.rect(x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
items.doc: A filled box on the screen.

items.name: tl.hud.frame
items.sig: tl.hud.frame(x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
items.doc: An outline on the screen.

items.name: tl.hud.text
items.doc: Words on the screen.

items.name: tl.hud.measure
items.doc: How wide and tall some words come out, in pixels, before they're drawn. For centring text or putting a box behind it.

items.name: tl.hud.pixel
items.doc: One screen pixel.

items.name: tl.hud.line
items.doc: A line on the screen.

items.name: tl.hud.size
items.doc: The screen's size: 480, 270.

items.name: tl.color
items.doc: A colour from 0 to 255 parts, a name ("red", "green", "yellow", "blue", "cyan", "purple", "pink", "orange", "white", "black", "ink", "muted", "gray") or a hex string ("#5fe08a").

items.name: tl.hsv
items.doc: A colour from hue (0 to 1), saturation and value.

groups.name: ui
groups.title: Windows
groups.about: Little windows a mod puts up. The function you give runs every frame and lists what is in the window, top to bottom.

items.name: tl.ui.toast
items.doc: A short message at the bottom of the screen.

items.name: tl.ui.window
items.doc: Open a window. fn(ui, window) runs every frame and fills it with labels, buttons and bars. opts: {x=, y=, w=}. The handle has close().

items.name: tl.ui.label
items.doc: A line of words.

items.name: tl.ui.button
items.doc: A button. True on the frame it was clicked.

items.name: tl.ui.toggle
items.doc: A switch. Give it the value, get the new value back.

items.name: tl.ui.slider
items.doc: A slider. Give it the value, get the new value back.

items.name: tl.ui.bar
items.doc: A progress bar, 0 to 1.

items.name: tl.ui.space
items.doc: A gap.

groups.name: input
groups.title: Keys and the mouse
groups.about: Read the keyboard and the mouse, or take the keys over for a game.

items.name: tl.input.key
items.doc: Is a key held right now? "a", "space", "left", "return"...

items.name: tl.input.capture
items.doc: While on, key presses go to this mod and not to the editor's shortcuts. Escape always gives them back.

items.name: tl.input.mouse
items.doc: {x, y, tile_x, tile_y, down}: where the mouse is on the screen and on the board.

groups.name: sound
groups.title: Sound
groups.about: The game's own sounds and a tiny synth.

items.name: tl.sound.play
items.doc: hover, click, confirm, tick, pop, boom, whoosh, zap, error, switch, thump, riser, crton, crtoff, glitch, snore, knock, sparkle.

items.name: tl.sound.note
items.doc: One note. tone is "square", "triangle", "sine" or "noise".

groups.name: store
groups.title: Saving
groups.about: What a mod remembers between sessions. Kept in the mod's own folder.

items.name: tl.store.get
items.doc: Read a saved value.

items.name: tl.store.set
items.doc: Save a value: numbers, strings, booleans and tables of them.

items.name: tl.camera.get
items.doc: Where the view is.

items.name: tl.camera.go
items.doc: Glide the view to a board position.

items.name: tl.camera.fit
items.doc: Fit the whole board in view.

items.name: tl.camera.focus
items.doc: Bring these parts into view.

groups.name: graph
groups.title: Extending the editor
groups.about: A mod can add its own node types to the visual scripting editor, for itself and for every other mod.

items.name: tl.graph.node
items.doc: Add a node type. def: {id=, cat=, title=, kind="action"|"value"|"event"|"flow", ins={{name, type, default}}, outs={{name, type}}, code=, expr=, tip=}. In code and expr, $name is an input and @name an output.
